en: Added MCP URL-mode elicitation on 2026-07-28 protocol connections, so servers can ask Claude Code to open a browser-based flow; no waiting dialog is left on screen when the server has no way to confirm completion
zh: 新增 2026-07-28 协议连接上的 MCP URL 模式 elicitation，使服务器可以要求 Claude Code 打开基于浏览器的流程；当服务器无法确认完成时，屏幕上不会留下等待对话框
